rules.title: Browser caches
rules.description: Chrome / Edge / Firefox caches — pages reload a bit slower once

rules.title: Developer caches
rules.description: Package-manager and tool caches — rebuilt when next used

rules.title: Previous Windows installation
rules.description: Windows.old holds your last Windows version so you can roll back. Windows deletes it on its own about ten days after an upgrade, and it is owned by the system — use Storage settings rather than the Recycle Bin.

rules.title: Windows Update cache
rules.description: Downloaded update packages Windows keeps after installing them. They regenerate, but the folder is system-owned, so let Windows clear it.

rules.title: Docker / WSL2 virtual disk
rules.description: A WSL2 virtual disk never shrinks by itself, even after you delete things inside it. The file IS your Linux or Docker data — reclaim the space from inside, then compact the disk.
